changelog: Centralized cron / scheduler: configure just ONE server cron (every minute → /cron/run.php) and the app runs every background job internally. WhatsApp queue, subscription/payment reminders, plan-expiry checks, daily auto-reports, AI-usage cleanup, update checks and an optional nightly database backup are now all driven from one place

Admin → Cron & Tasks: see each job's status (success/failed/running), last & next run, duration and message; enable/disable any job; run a job manually; 'Run all due now'; 'Retry failed'; per-job execution history; and a health banner that warns if the server cron isn't firing. The exact one-line cron command (with your secret) is shown ready to copy

Production-grade internals: per-job atomic DB locking prevents overlapping/duplicate runs (with stale-lock recovery), every run is logged with duration + outcome, and each job is isolated so one failure never blocks the others. Adding a future scheduled task is one line in the registry — no new server cron ever again. The old individual cron URLs still work (they now delegate to the same scheduler)

Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API integration (Admin → WhatsApp Cloud API): enter your Phone Number ID, WABA ID and Permanent Access Token, switch the provider to 'Cloud', and every message the system sends goes through Meta's official API. A 'Test Connection' shows your verified name, number and quality rating

Full template manager on the website: create Utility / Marketing / Authentication templates with header (text or image/document/video), body variables, footer and buttons (quick-reply, visit-URL, call, copy-code), submit them to Meta for approval, and see live Approved / Pending / Rejected status with the rejection reason — then delete or rebuild, all without leaving the admin panel

Send tab: fire off a text, an approved template (with variables + media header — works anytime), a media message, or interactive reply-buttons to any number, with the result (accepted or the exact Meta error) shown instantly

Conversations tab: a WhatsApp-style outbound log grouped by contact — every message the system sent, its trigger, and accepted-vs-failed with the precise failure reason. (Delivery/read ticks and incoming customer replies come only via Meta's webhook, which has no polling API; the rest works today. The legacy gateway stays available and can be switched back anytime.)

Fix (critical): the Staff App under /app now works — the base-URL detector didn't know about the new app/ and reception/ folders, so /app pages built wrong links and /app/waiter looped (ERR_TOO_MANY_REDIRECTS). Added them to the detector; the app, its icons, service worker and all three role screens now load correctly
Fix: opening /app/waiter, /app/kitchen or /app/reception directly no longer shows 'Page not found' — those URLs now redirect to the right screen (the app itself already routes there after login)

New database updates now apply automatically when the restaurant owner opens their panel too (not only the Super Admin) — so the Property Code and Reception role appear without waiting for an admin login

Master Staff App (installable): open menu.akdwk.in/app on any phone or tablet, tap your role — Waiter, Kitchen or Reception — and it shows that screen. 'Add to Home Screen' installs it like a real app (no Play Store needed); it works on both mobiles and tablets

One simple 4-digit Property Code per restaurant for staff login: your team just enters the Property Code (shown in Staff → Staff App) + their 4-digit PIN. The old restaurant-code/slug login still works too

New Reception role: a front-desk / captain screen that can take orders for any table and run the floor — advance live orders, clear table-service calls (Call Waiter/Bill) and confirm today's reservations — but cannot collect payment (that stays with the owner). Add reception staff in Staff with their own PIN

Call Waiter from the table: the menu now has a 'Call Waiter' button (Call / Bring Bill / Water / Clean table). Requests pop up instantly on the Kitchen board and the owner's Orders board with a chime + Hindi voice alert and a one-tap 'Done'

AI Business Advisor (client → AI Advisor): on demand it reads your last 30 days — sales, best & slow items, busiest hours/days, repeat customers — and gives 5-7 concrete, practical suggestions to grow revenue, in Gujarati + English (metered under AI cost)

Digital TV Menu Board (/r/tv.php?slug=…): a full-screen, auto-scrolling menu for a TV or screen in your shop, in your brand colours; it refreshes itself so menu edits appear automatically. Open it from the dashboard's 'TV Menu Board' tile

Table Reservations: guests can 'Book a Table' from the menu (name, mobile, date, time, party size); you get a WhatsApp alert, manage bookings in the new client 'Reservations' page, and the guest is auto-notified on WhatsApp when you confirm or cancel

AI Menu Chatbot (customer-facing): a floating assistant on every menu answers diners' questions — “what's Jain?”, “anything under ₹200?”, “what's your bestseller?” — grounded only in that restaurant's own menu, in English/Hindi/Gujarati. Admin-gated (Settings → AI) with a per-restaurant daily question cap so cost stays controlled; every call is metered under AI Usage

Reorder in one tap: after a diner orders, the menu remembers it on their device and shows an 'Order again' bar next visit that refills the cart and pre-fills their details (server still re-prices everything, so it's always accurate)

Loyalty Points & Rewards: customers earn points on every order (by mobile number) and redeem them for a discount on a future bill. Owners set the earn rate, minimum-to-redeem and a max-discount cap in the new client 'Loyalty' page, which also lists members and balances. The menu shows a diner's points and an opt-in 'use points' toggle at checkout, and confirms points earned on the thank-you screen

Diner Online Payment: restaurants can accept online payment (UPI/card/netbanking via Razorpay) for the bill, settling to their OWN Razorpay account. A 'Pay Online' button appears right after ordering with the exact amount; the order auto-marks Paid once verified, and if the diner skips it the order still stays payable at the counter. Configure in the new client 'Online Payment' page

Public menu now shows dietary tags: a Jain badge, a spice-level indicator (🔥 icons) and your custom item tags (e.g. 'Chef Special') — plus a new 'Jain' filter chip so diners can filter Jain items in one tap (uses the fields you already fill in the menu editor)

New client 'Customers' page (CRM): every diner who orders is remembered by mobile number — see visits, total spend, average order, last visit and their favourite items, with one-tap WhatsApp and a CSV export, so you can win back regulars
Reports now show a 'Busiest Hours' chart — the hour-by-hour order pattern for any date range highlights your peak hour so you can plan staff and time your offers

AI Description Writer in the menu editor: an 'AI Write' button next to Description writes an appetizing one-line description in English and Gujarati from the dish name (metered under AI cost like other AI features)

AI Token Usage & Cost Metering: every Gemini call now logs exact token counts (input/output/thinking/cached) from the provider's own usageMetadata and computes cost from an editable price table — no estimates

Admin → AI Usage & Cost: Overview (platform-key vs users'-key spend, daily cost chart, top users, warning banners), User-wise table with CSV export, per-user detail (model/feature breakdown, recent calls), Rates & Settings (edit prices, USD→local rate, markup, limits), and a monthly Billing report with markup + print/PDF
Each restaurant sees only its own 'AI Usage This Month' on its dashboard; clients can never see other users' data, prices or the platform key
Runaway-cost guard: oversized prompts are blocked pre-flight (logged as 'blocked'); alert threshold flags very large calls; logging is fire-and-forget so a logging failure never breaks the AI feature
Nightly cron (cron/ai_rollup.php) rolls usage into a daily table for fast dashboards and purges raw logs past the retention window; timezone-correct created_at

Fixed the public menu (/r/{slug}) not scrolling on mobile — a global overflow-x:hidden I'd added to <html> for the panels was breaking vertical scroll on phone browsers; it's now scoped to the admin/client panels only

Mobile modals now actually scroll: the body (not just the frame) is capped to the visible height, so every field below the fold (Plan, dates, status, password) is reachable while the header and Save button stay pinned
Mobile: tall admin pop-ups (Edit Client, Add/Edit Plan, Generate Invoice) now fit the phone screen — the header and Save button stay pinned while the form scrolls, so you can always reach Save

Configurable trial: Admin → Plans → 'Trial & Launch Offer' sets which plan new signups get during the trial (default: the best/most-featured plan, so trials are full-featured) and how many days it lasts

Launch offer: an automatic time-limited discount (default 50% within 24h of signup, configurable) — the client Plans page shows a live countdown banner and struck-through prices, and the discount is re-applied server-side on payment (never trusted from the browser)
Smart plan suggestion: the Plans page reads the restaurant's menu size and marks the best-fitting plan as 'Recommended' for them
Mobile: fixed the admin/client panels on phones — wider off-canvas menu with tap-to-close, no sideways page scroll, wide tables scroll so action buttons stay reachable, and modals fit the screen
Fixed the blank page after saving in SEO Manager and other new SEO pages (they now load their helpers directly, independent of a cached config.php)
SEO platform (Phase 1): central renderMeta() for unique title/description/canonical/robots/OG/Twitter/hreflang on every page, plus Search Console/Bing verification and GA4/GTM injection
Dynamic sitemap index at /sitemap.xml → pages, restaurants (auto-split at 40k, respects each client's indexing toggle), cities and blog children, cached 6h; dynamic /robots.txt

Programmatic city pages at /digital-menu/{city} (45+ Indian cities seeded incl. all major Gujarat towns) with 500+ words of unique local content, live restaurant listings, FAQ + LocalBusiness/Service/Breadcrumb schema; state pages and /qr-menu-for/{type} cuisine pages

Public menu SEO: keyword-rich auto title/description, full Restaurant + nested Menu + Breadcrumb JSON-LD (real ratings only), per-item alt text, and a client 'Allow Google indexing' toggle (noindex + sitemap exclusion when off)
Admin → SEO Manager: GSC/Bing/GA4/GTM settings, city-page manager with CSV bulk import, keyword tracker, redirect manager and a 404 log; IndexNow + Google/Bing sitemap ping on new menu publish

Custom 404 page with logging + redirect handling; security headers (HSTS, Permissions-Policy), GZIP and 1-year asset caching; homepage Organization + WebSite(SearchAction) + SoftwareApplication schema (removed the previous placeholder rating)
Website Analytics (Admin → Website Analytics): daily & all-time visitors across the whole platform, a 30-day trend chart and a 'top pages' breakdown of what people open most

Visitor counting is deduped per device per day (refreshes and repeat opens are never double-counted); bots, super-admin visits, AJAX and internal panel/API/asset requests are excluded; restaurant menus are grouped together

SEO built in: the landing page now has full meta/Open Graph/Twitter tags and SoftwareApplication structured data, each restaurant menu has local-SEO tags, plus a dynamic /sitemap.xml (every live menu) and robots.txt — so your site can rank when people search for a digital/QR menu

Refer & Earn: every restaurant gets a shareable referral link; when someone they invite buys any plan, the referrer automatically gets bonus days (default 30, configurable). New 'Refer & Earn' page with link, WhatsApp/Facebook share and referral history
Admin Marketing & Growth page: a ready-to-run Ads Kit (Google keywords + ad copy, Facebook/Instagram ad text in English + Gujarati, WhatsApp broadcast, hashtags) with one-click copy
Ad-budget tracker: shows total paid revenue and the share you want to reinvest in ads (default 50%, editable) for all-time and this month — so you know exactly how much to spend after each sale
Fixed WhatsApp buttons on the public menu (and support/renew links): numbers are now normalised with the 91 country code in every format, so the chat actually opens
OTP login now shows a clear on-screen confirmation ('OTP sent to your WhatsApp. Valid for 5 minutes.') — earlier nothing appeared
OTP resend has a 30-second countdown on the button plus a server-side 30s cooldown (and the existing max-3-in-5-minutes cap) to avoid repeat sends and control cost
OTP login accepts the mobile in any format (+91 / 0 / spaces) and matches it reliably

Animated hero on the landing page: an illustrated person presents a live phone that browses the menu, taps 'Add to Order' and shows an 'Order placed!' confirmation on a loop — with floating food, a cart badge and a gentle float
Signup always grants the free, unlimited 7-day trial (never a paid plan's long validity) and enables direct ordering so new users get the full experience

WhatsApp numbers are now accepted in any format — spaces, +91, 0091, leading 0, dashes, brackets — and normalised to a clean Indian number so the message always sends; the signup mobile field accepts these too
WhatsApp master switch now truly stops everything: turning it off in Admin → WhatsApp sends nothing (orders, welcome, reminders) and never queues 'pending' messages

New-order voice alert: the Orders board and Kitchen screen now play a chime and speak a short Hindi announcement ('आपके यहाँ एक नया ऑर्डर आया है, प्लीज़ देख लीजिए') when a new order arrives and sound is on
Colorful, print-ready invoice: every subscription payment gets a polished invoice (gradient header, PAID stamp, GST breakdown) — download it from client Plans → Billing history or Admin → Invoices
Plans & Billing for logged-in clients: a new page shows the current plan (with expiry / days left) and every available plan, clearly marking the one you're on

Buy or renew a plan from inside the panel with payment: online via Razorpay (auto-activates instantly) when configured, otherwise offline via UPI/GPay with a scan-to-pay QR and a 'send screenshot to WhatsApp' flow
Super Admin → Plan Requests: approve offline payments to activate/renew a restaurant's plan (marks the invoice paid and WhatsApps the client), or reject; a badge shows pending requests
Settings → Payments: set the UPI number (default 9978123146), UPI ID and payee name for offline subscription payments; Razorpay stays optional for online
Renewing the same plan early now stacks the new validity on remaining days instead of losing time
Menu scan counting made robust: counts every real menu open even before the analytics migration has run (the daily-views table is auto-created on first open)
Device-based dedup: one device counts once per day (resets next morning at 4am) so refreshes and repeat opens don't inflate the number; owner/super-admin previews are never counted

Discounts & Coupons: per-restaurant promo codes (flat/percent, min order, max-discount cap, usage limit, expiry) with a customer 'Have a coupon?' box in the cart and server-side re-validation on order placement
Menu scan analytics: per-restaurant daily opens on client & super-admin dashboards
POS-style order flow: owner Orders board simplified to New/Active, Completed and Cancelled
Payment collection: 'Complete & Collect Payment' with Cash / UPI / Card / Bank / Online / Due, cash change calculation
Standalone 'Mark Paid' on any unpaid order; payment mode + paid/unpaid shown in order detail and printed bill
Reports: payment breakdown by mode (cash vs bank vs UPI) plus paid vs unpaid dues for the date range
Widened orders.payment_mode to VARCHAR(20) (migration 1.0.4) with a safe auto-migrator on admin load
Fixed one-click update download (GitHub zipball HTTP 415): download by commit SHA with the correct Accept header
Updates: switched to simple branch/commit-based updates — set repo + branch + token once, then Check & Update straight from GitHub (no Releases needed)
Update Settings simplified to 3 fields (owner/repo, branch, token); branch is now free text
Version badge and history now track the git commit (like gh:abc1234)
One-click vegetarian Demo Menu (53 items, English + Gujarati, bundled photos)
Gemini: model auto-fallback (handles retired models), 429 retry, live Test tool in Settings
Fixed QR/menu images on cPanel; installer SQL import and JSON-safe errors
